title: 第5章 淬体液第6章 洗筋伐髓
content_zh:
秦家弃子名头也挺不错，返回中药大后，江凡也就按部就班老实上了两天课，发现中药学专业课程很肤浅，偶尔有兴趣听听较为感兴趣的课程。
班头倒是找江凡谈过一次话，江凡表示要自学其他专业课程，之后便不再过问江凡事宜，人生遭遇重大变故，自暴自弃也很正常，搞不好哪天会主动辍学。
至于授课的那些老教授，各个都是活了数十年的老狐狸，什么世面没有见过，万一哪天江凡回归燕京秦家，何必给自己找不自在，课前点名主动忽略江凡的名字。
不再按时上课后，江凡每晚雷打不动去紫金山修炼，早上回到宿舍休息三个小时，睡醒后便去学校图书馆看书，每天时间安排明明白白，不浪费一分一秒，生活那是一个充实。
半个月下来，修炼进步斐然，在《混沌造化诀》逆天功法加持下，四肢百骸和丹田内灵气累计有九成之多，预计两三天便可突破炼气修为；在图书馆收获同样不小，有强悍的神识和记忆力，中医、中药相关书籍差不多全扫了一遍，基本掌握地球上中医药相关知识。
互联网那玩意挺不错，虽然网络上信息较少，但还是能查询到不少有用的信息，学习了不少地球上自然、地理等信息，也了解到一些未解之谜和奇闻异事，真假无法确认，也有可能是以讹传讹。
至于答应去金陵大学给李子茜做挡箭牌，很不巧，李子茜离开中药大次日，有一位感染流感燕京患者进入金陵，在金陵逛了不少景区，导致全市风声鹤唳，各大高校无奈再次施行严格封控措施，江凡哪还有空去做什么挡箭牌。
令叶凡郁闷的是，如今身上有九万巨款，想要购买些中药材配置淬体液，可水西门中药材批发市场已封控四个月多，逛了几家中药材店铺，药材种类太少，配不齐淬体液的药材。
其实中药大最不缺的就是中药材，基本上囊括了地球上大部分中药材，可那些中药材是用于教学和科研，江凡总不至于偷偷潜入中药学院的科研楼，干出令人不齿之事。
要不去水西门中药材批发市场借点药材？放下手中书籍，江凡大脑快速运转，鬼知道流感什么时候结束，他可不想浪费宝贵修炼时间，等疫情结束后再去购买药材炼体！
好像有点不太靠谱，潜入中药材批发市场很容易，可各个店铺有卷帘门锁着，店铺内各种药材肯定要做防潮处理，想要在成百上千个袋子里寻找十几种药材没那么容易。
相对来说，还是在自家中药学院借点药材更加靠谱，各种药材非常齐全，每样药材稍微借点也看不出来，大不了以后发达了向学校捐点善款。
说干就干，来到经常翻墙的角落，轻松一跃跳出校外，街道上空荡荡，几乎没什么行人，不少餐厅关门歇业，也有不少店铺贴上转让或出租的广告，也就那些黑网吧的生意不错。
二十大洋买了一套耐克黑色运动服，三大洋买了一顶帽子，两大洋买了一捆塑料袋，没有回学校，在玄武湖公园随便找了个偏僻角落，盘膝坐下运转功法，地球不爆炸，修炼不停止。
月黑风高，一袭黑衣的江凡返回校园，除了路灯，也就每栋教学楼保安室亮着灯，偶尔有几个保安定时巡逻，倒是为江凡提供了不少便利。
轻松跳上科研楼二楼小阳台，轻车熟路来到一楼中药材库房，外放神识，一根铁丝轻松打开铁锁，轻声关上房门，事情就是如此简单。
剩下的事情更简单，直接打开手电筒寻找药材，药材库房是恒温环境，窗户早已被封住，也不用担心手电筒的光线被外人发现。
也没有想象中的那么简单，植物类中药材大约有余种，动物类中药材大约有1500种，矿物类中药材大约有500种，很多药材极为相似，对中药材不熟悉的话，三天三夜也不一定能找到需要的十几种药材。
方圆半米的神识着实有些垃圾，要是有百丈神识的话，分分钟钟可以覆盖整个库房的药柜，轻松扫到药柜里的药材种类，可惜也只能想想而已。
白芍，不错，上等的白芍，半夏、厚朴同样是上等的好药材，中药大不愧是药学最高等学府，库房里存放中药材不是中药店里那些药材可以相提并论。

即使对各类中药材有着深刻了解，江凡还是耗费两个小时才找到需要的十二种药材，至于淬体液需要的鹿茸和麝香，想想还是算了，普通药材少点没什么，贵重药材少了容易被发现。
又当又立！
在紫金山修炼一夜，江凡迫不及待来到新街口的草本堂，勉强中等的鹿茸八十元一克，天然麝香更是高达两百三十元一克，含泪花费四万高价买了不到半斤药材，也仅仅只能配十副淬体液。
没办法，鹿茸来自雄性梅花鹿的幼角，麝香来自雄性原麝的香囊，因珍贵药用价值被大肆捕猎，如今国内梅花鹿可能不足千只，原麝更是可能不足百只，不贵那才是真正的见鬼。
更令江凡震惊的是，草本堂镇店之宝是一株药龄一百二十多年的长白山野人参，26克左右，一口价160万，平均一克高达6.15万！
想到在地球修炼非常烧钱，可怎么也没想到烧钱会这么狠，真心伤不起，以后炼丹需要什么名贵珍稀药材，买是买不起，只能去那些无人区的深山老林里寻找。
配置淬体液药方颇为麻烦，各种药材的药效参差不齐，江凡需要品尝每一种药材的药效，再根据各种药材的药效，搭配不同分量的药材，组成淬体液的新药方，而且每副淬体液药方药效要逐步提升。
至于炼体效果更为霸道的淬体丹，江凡也只能想想而已，炼气二层的修为勉强支撑炼制一些低级丹药，可巧妇难为无米之炊，真的修炼到炼气二层又如何，没有药材和丹炉，拿什么东西来炼丹？
在紫金山忙活了三个小时，颇为顺利配置了十副淬体液药材，内心难免有些失望，从学校借了五千多元药材，又花费四万出头买了些药材，配置出来的东西却差强人意，也仅仅只能泡十天药浴。
算了，想那么多干什么，如今正是为修炼打基础黄金期，有淬体液炼体总比没有的好，人的欲望无穷无尽，要学会知足，知足才能常乐。

content_en:
The abandoned son of the Qin family also had a pretty good reputation. After returning to the University of Traditional Chinese Medicine, Jiang Fan attended classes step by step for two days. He found that the courses in the Traditional Chinese Medicine major were very superficial, and occasionally he was interested in listening to more interesting courses.
The class leader actually talked to Jiang Fan once. Jiang Fan said that he would study other professional courses on his own and would no longer ask anything about Jiang Fan's affairs. It was normal for him to give up on himself when he encountered major changes in his life. He might drop out of school one day.
As for the old professors who teach, each of them is an old fox who has lived for decades and has never seen anything in the world. If Jiang Fan returns to the Qin family in Yanjing one day, why bother to make himself uncomfortable? He took the initiative to ignore Jiang Fan's name during roll call before class.
After he no longer attended classes on time, Jiang Fan went to Purple Mountain every night to practice. He returned to his dormitory to rest for three hours in the morning. After waking up, he went to the school library to read. His daily schedule was clear and he did not waste a single second. His life was fulfilling.
After half a month, I have made remarkable progress in my practice. With the blessing of the "Chaos Creation Technique", the spiritual energy in my limbs and Dantian has accumulated to 90%. It is expected that I will be able to break through the Qi practice in two or three days. I also gained a lot in the library. I have strong spiritual consciousness and memory. I have scanned almost all books related to traditional Chinese medicine and traditional Chinese medicine, and I have basically mastered the knowledge related to traditional Chinese medicine on the earth.
The Internet is quite good. Although there is less information on the Internet, I can still find a lot of useful information. I have learned a lot of natural and geographical information on the earth, and I have also learned about some unsolved mysteries and anecdotes. The authenticity cannot be confirmed, and it may be rumored.
As for agreeing to go to Jinling University to serve as a shield for Li Ziqian, unfortunately, the day after Li Ziqian left the University of Traditional Chinese Medicine, a Yanjing patient infected with influenza entered Jinling and visited many scenic spots in Jinling. This caused the whole city to be in panic. Major universities had no choice but to implement strict lockdown measures again. Jiang Fan had no time to use as a shield.
What makes Ye Fan depressed is that he now has a huge sum of 90,000 yuan and wants to buy some Chinese medicinal materials to prepare the body quenching liquid. However, the Shuiximen Chinese medicinal materials wholesale market has been closed for more than four months. He visited several Chinese herbal medicine stores and found that there were too few types of medicinal materials and there was not enough medicinal materials for the body quenching liquid.
In fact, the most indispensable thing in Chinese medicine is Chinese medicinal materials, which basically include most of the Chinese medicinal materials on the earth. However, those Chinese medicinal materials are used for teaching and scientific research. Jiang Fan will not sneak into the scientific research building of the School of Chinese Medicine and do something disgusting.
How about going to Shuiximen Traditional Chinese Medicine Wholesale Market to borrow some medicinal materials? Putting down the book in his hand, Jiang Fan's brain was working rapidly. Who knows when the flu will end? He didn't want to waste his precious training time and wait until the epidemic was over to buy medicinal materials for body training!
It seems a bit unreliable. It is easy to sneak into the wholesale market of Chinese medicinal materials, but each store has a locked rolling shutter door. All kinds of medicinal materials in the store must be treated with moisture-proof treatment. It is not that easy to find a dozen kinds of medicinal materials in hundreds or thousands of bags.
Relatively speaking, it is more reliable to borrow some medicinal materials from your own school of traditional Chinese medicine. All kinds of medicinal materials are very complete. It is not obvious if you borrow a little bit of each medicinal material. At worst, you can donate some money to the school when you are prosperous.
Just do what you say, go to the corner where you often climb over the wall, and easily jump out of the school. The streets are empty, there are almost no pedestrians, many restaurants are closed, and many shops have advertisements for transfer or rental. The business of those black Internet cafes is good.
Twenty Dayang bought a set of black Nike sportswear, San Dayang bought a hat, and Two Dayang bought a bundle of plastic bags. Instead of going back to school, he found a remote corner in Xuanwu Lake Park, sat down cross-legged, and started practicing the exercises. If the earth does not explode, the cultivation will not stop.
The moon was dark and the wind was high. Jiang Fan, dressed in black, returned to campus. In addition to the street lights, the security rooms of each teaching building had lights on. Occasionally, there were a few security guards patrolling regularly, which provided Jiang Fan with a lot of convenience.
Easily jump onto the small balcony on the second floor of the scientific research building, and arrive at the Chinese herbal medicine warehouse on the first floor with ease.Room, let out your spiritual consciousness, easily open the iron lock with a wire, and close the door softly, it's that simple.
The rest is simpler, just turn on the flashlight and look for medicinal materials. The medicinal materials warehouse is a constant-temperature environment and the windows have long been sealed. There is no need to worry about the light of the flashlight being discovered by outsiders.
It is not as simple as imagined. There are about more than 1,500 kinds of plant-based Chinese medicinal materials, about 1,500 kinds of animal-based Chinese medicinal materials, and about 500 kinds of mineral-based Chinese medicinal materials. Many medicinal materials are very similar. If you are not familiar with Chinese medicinal materials, you may not be able to find the dozens of medicinal materials you need in three days and three nights.
The spiritual consciousness with a radius of half a meter is really rubbish. If you have the spiritual consciousness of a hundred feet, you can cover the entire medicine cabinet in the warehouse in minutes, and easily scan the types of medicinal materials in the medicine cabinet. Unfortunately, you can only think about it.
White peony root, yes, high-quality white peony root, pinellia ternata, and Magnolia officinalis are also high-quality medicinal materials. The University of Chinese Medicine is worthy of being the highest institution of pharmacy. The Chinese medicinal materials stored in the warehouse are not comparable to those in traditional Chinese medicine stores.
Even though he had a deep understanding of various types of Chinese medicinal materials, it still took Jiang Fan two hours to find the twelve needed medicinal materials. As for the velvet antler and musk needed for body fluid quenching, he thought about it and forgot about it. It wouldn't matter if there were less common medicinal materials, but it would be easy to find the precious medicinal materials if they were lacking.
Stand and stand again!
After practicing in Zijin Mountain for a night, Jiang Fan couldn't wait to go to the Herbal Hall in Xinjiekou. The deer antlers were barely 80 yuan per gram, and the natural musk was as high as 230 yuan per gram. He spent a tearful price of 40,000 yuan to buy less than half a kilogram of medicinal materials, and he could only prepare ten pairs of body tempering fluids.
No way, the antlers come from the young antlers of male sika deer, and the musk comes from the sachet of male musk deer. They are hunted for their precious medicinal value. There may be less than a thousand sika deer in the country today, and there may be less than a hundred musk deer. It’s really damn expensive.
What shocked Jiang Fan even more was that the treasure of the Caobentang store was a Changbai Mountain wild ginseng with a medicinal history of more than 120 years. It weighed about 26 grams and had a fixed price of 1.6 million, with an average price of 61,500 per gram!
I thought that cultivating on earth would be very expensive, but I never thought that the money would be so expensive. I really can’t afford to be hurt. I can’t afford to buy any precious and rare medicinal materials needed for alchemy in the future, so I can only look for them in the deep mountains and old forests in uninhabited areas.
It is quite troublesome to prepare the body quenching liquid prescription. The efficacy of various medicinal materials is uneven. Jiang Fan needs to taste the efficacy of each medicinal material, and then mix different amounts of medicinal materials according to the medicinal efficacy of each medicinal material to form a new body quenching liquid prescription, and the efficacy of each body quenching liquid prescription must be gradually improved.
As for the Body Tempering Pill, which has a more overbearing effect in refining the body, Jiang Fan can only think about it. The cultivation level of the second level of Qi Refining can barely support the refining of some low-level elixirs.
After working hard in Purple Mountain for three hours, I successfully prepared ten pairs of medicinal materials for quenching the body fluid. I was inevitably a little disappointed. I borrowed more than 5,000 yuan of medicinal materials from the school and spent more than 40,000 to buy some medicinal materials. However, the prepared items were not satisfactory, and I could only take a medicinal bath for ten days.
Forget it, why are you thinking so much? Now is the golden period to lay the foundation for cultivation. It is better to refine the body with body quenching fluid than without. People's desires are endless. You must learn to be content. Only by being content can you always be happy.
